name: outsystems-sprint-loop-pack
description: OutSystems ODC sprint loop for coding agents: scaffold a project, turn a PRD into a screen inventory and capability plan, design each screen as a validated OutSystems UI blueprint, drive ODC Mentor to implement and publish, run BDD tests, and audit the live runtime UI. Seven skills plus the shared reference set.

com.anthropic.claude.note: Claude Code auto-discovers skills/ and ignores this manifest. The OutSystems tenant MCP server is not declared here: step 0 of the loop (outsystems-sprint-init) registers it per project in that project's .mcp.json.
